# Addax Tower Office Space — Aegis Coworking

> Aegis Coworking - ADGM rents office space on Level 38 of Addax Tower (Office 3812), Al Reem Island, RT3, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates — inside the Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM) jurisdiction. Serviced private offices start from AED 4,500 per month, dedicated desks AED 1,150, flexi desks AED 1,000 and virtual offices from AED 292. Leases are ADGM-compliant and registered on AccessRP.

Focus: The building and location: finding Aegis in Addax Tower (Level 38, Office 3812), visiting, and what is on the floor.

This site (addaxtower.online) is a one-page guide to renting office space in Addax Tower, published by Aegis Coworking, a business centre and space provider in Abu Dhabi Global Market.
